headline: Hackers Steal Record $6.3 Billion in Cryptocurrency From Binance
summary: Hackers stole roughly $6.3 billion in cryptocurrency from Binance in the sector's largest theft to date, prompting an investigation by the U.S. Secret Service and other agencies.
why: Binance is the world's largest digital asset exchange by trading volume, and major security breaches can destabilize liquidity and investor confidence across crypto markets.

impacts.name: BNB
impacts.why: The native token of Binance faces selling pressure following a record $6.3 billion cyber theft from the platform.
